sources.citation: Joseph E. LeDoux (1995). Emotion: Clues from the Brain. Annual Review of Psychology.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1995) in Annual Review of Psychology establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Joseph E. LeDoux (2000). Emotion Circuits in the Brain. Annual Review of Neuroscience.
sources.notes: LeDoux (2000 Annual Review of Neuroscience) canonical circuit synthesis of thalamo-amygdala and thalamo-cortico-amygdala auditory fear conditioning.

sources.citation: Michael T. Rogan, Ursula V. Stäubli, Joseph E. LeDoux (1997). Fear conditioning induces associative long-term potentiation in the amygdala. Nature.
sources.notes: Rogan, Stäubli & LeDoux (1997 Nature) in-vivo demonstration that fear conditioning induces associative long-term potentiation in lateral amygdala.

sources.citation: LM Romanski, JE LeDoux (1992). Equipotentiality of thalamo-amygdala and thalamo-cortico-amygdala circuits in auditory fear conditioning. The Journal of Neuroscience.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (1992) in The Journal of Neuroscience extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Michael S Fanselow, Joseph E LeDoux (1999). Why We Think Plasticity Underlying Pavlovian Fear Conditioning Occurs in the Basolateral Amygdala. Neuron.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (1999) in Neuron extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Kevin S LaBar (2025). Fear, learning, and the amygdala: a personal reflection in honor of Joseph LeDoux. Cerebral Cortex.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2025) in Cerebral Cortex extending the foundational findings.
